mem.9:
Conversation between Sam and Evan

18 May 2023
- Evan had recently returned from a family hiking trip in the Rockies, loved the views, and shared a lake-and-mountains photo. His old car had broken down, was repaired, then sold; he now drove a Prius.
- Sam loves hiking but hadn’t gone in years; recalled a special hike with their dad at age 10 and shared a forest-walking photo. Sam was considering painting as a relaxing hobby and shared a paint set. Evan had watercolor-painted for years, introduced by a friend; painting helped him de-stress. He shared a cactus/desert painting and encouraged Sam to try. Sam was excited. Sam also shared a sunset photo with feet on a car dashboard.

24 May 2023
- Evan described a family trip to Jasper the prior weekend: drove Icefields Parkway, saw glaciers and lakes, stayed in a cozy cabin in the mountains/forest. He found it peaceful and shared a glacier photo. Sam had never been and thought it looked breathtaking.
- Sam had a tough week and felt discouraged by a doctor’s check-up/weight reading; asked for advice. Evan suggested enjoyable exercise and small diet changes. Painting might relieve stress but wouldn’t affect weight. Sam planned to paint without pressure.

6 June 2023
- Evan said life was a rollercoaster; the previous week he’d had a sudden, frightening heart-palpitations episode that prompted lifestyle changes. Sam was glad he felt better and shared vegetables and milk. Evan was eating less processed food and fewer sugary snacks, though ginger snaps remained a weakness; Sam still liked soda and candy.
- Evan suggested flavored seltzer instead of soda, dark chocolate instead of candy, and offered to work out together/teach basic exercises. Sam agreed to try swaps and was keen to exercise. Sam complained supermarket self-checkouts were all broken; Evan sympathized.

27 July 2023
- Sam said friends had mocked Sam’s weight on Friday 21 July, hurting them and prompting lifestyle changes. Evan apologized, offered to work on health together, and stressed patience. He’d struggled with health a few years earlier; diet, exercise, and lifestyle changes helped.
- Evan encouraged reducing sugary snacks, eating produce, and swapping soda for flavored seltzer. Sam was reducing soda/candy, found it difficult but was determined. Evan suggested fruit or air-popped popcorn and mentioned *The Great Gatsby* as a “mystery” novel. He emphasized progress over perfection and shared motivational “let it shine” cards, gym card, produce, snacks, and hiking images.
- Sam planned to start gym/exercise regularly on 28 July. Evan encouraged persistence and fun, and offered support.

7 August 2023
- Evan had gone to Canada the prior week and met an “awesome Canadian woman”; described a movie-like connection that made him feel alive. Sam congratulated him and sympathized about his health.
- Evan said she was fun and energizing. Ginger snaps were still his weakness; his two-year health journey had ups and downs, making him appreciate good moments. Family motivated him. His fitness watch tracked progress; hikes/adventure and caring for a bonsai (symbol of strength/resilience) also motivated him. They agreed small consistent steps build resilience. Evan accidentally called Sam by the wrong name; warm goodbye.

13 August 2023
- Evan had returned from a Canada vacation with his new significant other; they hiked, biked, and did outdoor activities. Sam said life was challenging and affecting their health. Friends helped Sam stay positive; a motivational note said, “Don't fear it, just take the first step. It's been helping me move forward to healthier habits!” They agreed small wins matter.
- Evan had misplaced his keys (often loses them; searched half an hour). Sam described an amazing dream of flying over skyscrapers. Evan suggested a dream-interpretation book. Sam said the health journey felt endless but rewarding; they encouraged each other and Evan told Sam to rest.

15 August 2023
- Evan’s son hurt his ankle in a soccer accident on Saturday 12 August; Evan cared for him and took him to the doctor. It was improving, sore but nothing serious.
- Sam had a tough week and a doctor’s appointment that prompted better self-care; was taking a cooking class. Sam enjoyed it, made grilled salmon with vegetables, shared a photo, and offered recipes, including easy roasted vegetables. Evan wanted ideas to add vegetables to meals.
- Sam felt concerned but motivated about health, taking one step at a time. Evan said feeling overwhelmed was okay and encouraged small steps.

19 August 2023
- Sam announced starting a diet and healthier lifestyle; it was tough but Sam was determined. Shared a spinach, avocado, and strawberry bowl. Reported more energy and feeling less sluggish after meals.
- Sam shared a grilled chicken-and-vegetable stir-fry recipe (photo of two bowls with chopsticks/sauce). Sauce was homemade; Sam offered and sent the recipe via photo of a recipe card with a vase-of-flowers drawing. Evan said he’d try it.
- Evan had started painting classes a few days earlier, to meet like-minded people/show his work and improve, despite already painting. A friend’s painting had originally inspired him to start years earlier. He enjoyed painting for peace/self-expression. Class focused on watercolors, observing nature and painting what they saw. He likes landscapes and capturing nature’s peaceful “vibe”; shared forest scene on easel, art supplies, watercolor table, ocean-sunset painting, and pink-flowered tree.
- Evan reminisced about road trips in his trusty car and shared a truck in a forest. The previous month he’d driven to Banff and skied; loved the snow and planned to return next year. Enjoys skiing, snowboarding, and ice skating. Sam would like to ski but worried their body couldn’t handle it; Evan hoped Sam could join him someday. Sam thanked him for understanding.

27 August 2023
- Sam said they had started a new diet and exercise routine on Monday 21 August and felt great. Evan had twisted his knee on Friday 25 August; it was very painful and disrupted his usual fitness routine, which frustrated him because being active was important. He hoped to get physical therapy; meanwhile he was taking it easy and swimming.
- Sam sympathized, suggested low-impact activity or PT, and encouraged swimming. Evan referred to a book he’d mentioned earlier, saying it got better with every page and he couldn’t put it down; the title/book is not identified in this exchange.
- Evan found a photo while tidying, from a road trip the previous month (July 2023). The photo showed a car parked by a lake with mountains behind it. He said the scenery and nature relaxed him. He went to the Rocky Mountains and found it refreshing and relaxing. Sam loves nature but hadn’t taken a road trip in ages; hiking can be challenging, but Sam hoped improved health would make a road trip and hike possible.
- Evan suggested more hikes and proposed they hike together sometime. He showed a lake-and-mountain photo and recommended that lake, with nearby trails. The lake’s name is unspecified; it is a two-hour drive from where they were. Sam said a day trip was doable and planned to go check it out. Warm farewells.
